about_the_game:
A fleet stands ready under your command as you step into a vast galaxy teeming with rival factions, opportunities, and danger. Battle space pirates, navigate the tangled politics of stellar powers, trade across star systems, expand your fleet, and uncover secrets and treasures lost in the void. As your wealth and influence grow, so too will your power to shape the fate of the galaxy…

Embark on a Galactic Journey

The stars await you. In this grand cosmic sandbox, write your own legend the way you see fit—build fleets, dominate trade, carve out territory. But as you rise, a threat that could shake the entire galaxy begins to stir…

Dynamic Economy

A reactive economy system models supply and demand across the galaxy. Every trade, every war shifts the economic balance. There’s profit to be made—for those smart enough to seize it.

Intense Bullet-Hell Battles

Battles unfold across astronomical distances in dazzling displays of bullet-hell combat—each clash a ballet of fire and motion in the dark void. Arm yourself with the finest equipment and skills, and shine on the battlefield like never before.

Write Your Space Opera

Command fleets in conflict, lead a faction to power, or rally the galaxy against an apocalyptic threat. Your strategic and tactical choices will determine the fate of star systems and the story that unfolds across the stars.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10 or above
  • Processor: Dual core CPU
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Support Vulkan

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: In this bullet-hell strategy sandbox game, lead your newly-formed fleet through a vast galaxy. Use your tactics and skills to amass wealth, build influence, engage in galactic affairs, and face the conflicts and crises threatening the entire star system.
